items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector redraw uploaded in 2007
items.tradition: Small seal-script style representation of 彡
items.caption: A modern seal-style redraw of 彡, the graphic-semantic element in the conventional account of 影. Historical accounts describe 影 as 景 with 彡 added to distinguish the shadow writing; this image shows 彡 alone.
items.alt: Three black, curved strokes sweep diagonally upward across a white square, forming 彡.
items.selection_reason: It correctly identifies the supplied asset and illustrates the component named in the reported 景-plus-彡 account. It is not an early artifact or an example of the complete character 影.
items.rights: The exact Commons description page states public-domain reuse for this ancient-script representation.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector redraw uploaded in 2014
items.tradition: Small seal-script style representation of 景
items.caption: A modern seal-style redraw of 景, the graph that historical accounts describe as used for shadow before 彡 was added in 影.
items.alt: A black seal-style graph for 景, with 日 above 京, centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: Pairs the correctly identified 景 base with the 彡 component to help explain the reported graphic differentiation. Neither modern redraw documents an early compound form of 影.
items.rights: The exact Commons description page states public-domain reuse for this ancient-script representation.

limitations.text: Both selected glyphs are modern digital redrawings in Shuowen seal-script style. They illustrate the separately sourced graphs 景 and 彡 but do not document a dated ancient occurrence or the precise appearance of an early 影.
